items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: he played extra with me... I said, Bill, you play Trummel today, get your brother on a drum... I said, okay, we have a funeral like that... I said, you play with the brass band... I said, okay, we'll tell him.

ctx.x: Right in the Allen house. Mm-hmm. So that was the first one when I went on the street outside that little field band. Yeah. You doop, Yeah.
That's our dance. I wondered about Ramus, your oldest brother. Which brass band did he work with?

Allen was his famous band. That was the main one. Allen, the old man Henry Allen brass band. Mm-hmm. Was his favorite band. And he played bass drummers there. He was strictly the bass drum player in that band because...
